blocks.content: Equal graphs are defined based on the equality of their vertex and edge sets.
Two graphs are said to be equal if and only if their corresponding vertex and edge set are identical. This concept is commonly used to compare the structure of graphs.

blocks.alt: G1 and G2 are Equal Graphs

blocks.content: Here, only the graphs G1 and G2 are equal.
